name: mind-reader
description: Spots a shape in the traffic and suggests the fitting next step in another tab.
author: Plonix

suggest.title: path & file access on {method} {path}
suggest.why: The "{param}" input carries a file path ("{value}"). Open it in Scans to check whether it can be pointed at files it shouldn't reach.
suggest.note: Plonix has no built-in path-traversal check yet, so nothing is pre-picked here. Add one from the Market, or change the path on the Bench and watch the response.

suggest.title: XML parsing on {method} {path}
suggest.why: This endpoint parses XML ({ct}). Open it in Scans to check how the parser handles external entities and referenced documents.
suggest.note: Plonix has no built-in XML-parsing check yet, so nothing is pre-picked here. Add one from the Market, or edit the body on the Bench and compare responses.
This looks like an admin or internal area. Replay it as each saved user and signed out to see who can reach it.

suggest.chip: Open the token on the Bench
suggest.note: This request carries a JWT. Open it on the Bench to decode and tweak the claims, then replay and compare.

suggest.title: Cookie set without HttpOnly on {method} {path}
suggest.note: A Set-Cookie here has no HttpOnly flag, so page scripts can read it. Confirm it is a session or auth cookie before reporting — some cookies are meant to be readable.
